blind.description: A low, circular stone basin or mortar tub constructed from three stacked tiers of grey carved stone bricks. The tub is filled to the rim with white coarse salt crystals or natron powder, with small frosty patches resting on the stone rim. A small carved wooden scoop rests nestled into the salt with its handle angled upward and outward over the rim.
blind.from_above: A circular grey stone ring enclosing a bumpy bed of white salt granules, with a light-brown wooden scoop handle pointing toward the upper-right.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1/4 the height of the figure (around 1.5 ft tall) and roughly 2.5 ft in diameter.
